lines.t: Walking through the fire, but I'm not alone
God's light is shining, guiding me home
Every storm I face, he give me the strength
Turning every trial into victory at length
Feet on the rock, my foundation is sure
Through every battle, His love will endure With faith in my heart, I rise above
Victorious through the power of His love No fear, no doubt, I stand and say
By His hand, I will overcome today Through every storm, I'll walk His way
By His hand, I will overcome today Chains fall away, the enemy can't win
Through every battle, God's voice calls me in
Armor on my soul, I walk unshaken
Every step I take, His glory's awakened
Prayer in my chest, sword of the Spirit
I fight with His truth, I will firmly stand
Through valleys low, through mountains high
I trust the Lord, His truth is my guide
Every fear fades, every shadow departs
Cause He lights the path and strengthens my heart
Storms may roar, but my hope won't fade
Yahushua has conquered, his power displayed
Every trial a lesson, every pain refined
I rise in his love, leaving doubt behind
Victory's mine, not by my might
But through the Savior who brings the light
Stand tall, walk strong, in his name I fight
Through the darkest hour, he is my light
No chain can bind me, no fear can stay By his hand I rise, I overcome today
Every battle faced, every tear I've cried He's been my rock, always by my side
Faith is my armor, prayer is my shield Through him alone, every wound is healed
Marching forward, I'll never retreat With God as my guide, I cannot be beat
Lift up your hands, the praises roar Victory in Yahushua forevermore
The world may shake, the night may fall But His power reigns above it all
With faith in my heart, I rise above Victorious through the power of His love
No fear, no doubt, I stand and say By His hand I overcome today
Through every storm, I'll walk his way By his hand, I'll overcome today
Hands lifted high, let the world hear my praise I'll walk in his victory all of my days
Thank you.
